name: Gas Meter
description: This will output a quantity in litres and the total capacity in litres.
shortDescription: A device to measure how much gas is within an enclosed volume.

logicNodes.label: Gas Level
logicNodes.description: Returns the number of litres of gas in an enclosed volume.

logicNodes.label: Fluid Capacity
logicNodes.description: Returns the total capacity of an enclosed volume in litres, or 0 if not enclosed.

logicNodes.label: Composite Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs the volumes of individual gas types on their respective channel. The data can be directly merged with a Liquid meter. The Air fluid type is equivalent to the sum of the oxygen, carbon dioxide and nitrogen values. Channels: 4-Air, 5-CO2, 8-Steam, 11-Oxygen, 12-Nitrogen, 13-Hydrogen.
